_comment: Jupiter /swap/v2/order response shapes for the open/close HTTP tests. The `transaction` fields are placeholder base64 strings (buy-order/sell-order fixture markers): these tests assert the client plumbing (URL/query, normalized fields, execute round-trip), while byte-level signing/serialization is covered in tests/soltx.test.mjs against the real mainnet fixtures. `quoteOnly` is the no-taker sell-side price probe (transaction === null).
